verification_notes.investigated_but_not_a_regression: A first full verify-deploy.sh --findings run (taken WHILE other concurrent Bash tool calls were also running in this same dispatch, i.e. a contended, non-idle measurement, explicitly invalid per the dispatch's own 'contention invalidates these measurements' clause) showed 2 gate8 suite failures beyond the 3 named pre-existing ones: test-deploy-verify-wiring.sh and test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh. Investigated directly, standalone, on a quieter host (load ~1.8-3.4): test-deploy-verify-wiring.sh resolves verify-deploy.sh deploy-tree-first and is exercising the STALE, unredeployed .claude/ copy (the same known deploy-staleness class already logged in dispatch_seq 9's issues.jsonl for test-lint-shellcheck.sh) -- resolved by Phase 11's redeploy, not a regression. test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's own baseline-cleanliness precondition fails because gate20's eager-load total is already 988B over baseline -- the SAME pre-existing, explicitly-excluded-from-this-work gate20 finding the dispatch already names, cascading into 'later cases are unreliable' rather than a distinct new defect. Neither is caused by Phase 9 or Phase 10's own edits.
verification_notes.gate8_full_battery_deferred_to_phase_11: Phase 10's own Tier Justification names TWO checks: the two targeted suites (done, 12/12 + 19/19 passing, covering the exact code path this phase changed) AND a complete `verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 8` run (the full 147-suite regression net). Attempted the latter twice via the bounded local-background-waiter pattern (kill -0 liveness polling on a captured pid, no harness async-wait): first bound 570s, then an additional 560s (1130s / ~19min total), during which ps --forest confirmed genuine, non-stalled progress (the pool was actively cycling through different suites each check, not stuck on one). Host load climbed from ~1.5 to 12+ during the wait (confirmed via `uptime`), attributable to the OTHER concurrently-active sibling orchestrator sessions documented in this environment, not to this phase's own change -- exactly the cross-session contention class the dispatch's own measured-evidence section names as invalidating a timing/completion measurement. Terminated the process group cleanly (verified no orphaned descendants via `ps aux` afterward) rather than continue consuming the wait budget on a check Phase 11 is explicitly chartered to redo correctly anyway (its own task list: 'Run the complete gate set with an explicit source-store target' plus the mandated idle-machine, load<2 before/after measurement). Deferring the SAME check to the phase built to do it properly, once, on an actually-idle host, rather than attempting a second redundant/contended run here.
